_comment: Synthetic postings for the demo and tests, in the shapes of each board's public API (Greenhouse Job Board API, Lever Postings API, Ashby job posting API). Not real jobs.

acme-analytics.title: Senior Data Engineer
acme-analytics.content: <p>Acme Analytics is hiring a Senior Data Engineer to join our hybrid Denver team.</p><p>Requirements</p><ul><li>5+ years of experience building data pipelines</li><li>Strong Python and SQL</li><li>Airflow and AWS in production</li><li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience</li></ul><p>Nice to have</p><ul><li>Kafka and dbt</li></ul>

acme-analytics.title: Data Engineer, Platform
acme-analytics.content: <p>This role is remote (US). Candidates must reside in Colorado, Utah or Texas.</p><p>Requirements</p><ul><li>3+ years of experience</li><li>Python, Spark, Kubernetes, Terraform and Golang</li></ul><p>We are unable to sponsor visas for this position.</p>

acme-analytics.title: Marketing Manager
acme-analytics.content: <p>Own campaigns. Requirements: 4+ years of experience in marketing.</p>
